g.text: A missingness model is an assumption, not a repair button.
2,000 datasets per scenario. 95% Monte Carlo intervals: normal for bias; Wilson for coverage.
IPW has known response probabilities only under MCAR/MAR. Full outcomes are an unavailable-in-practice oracle.
